text.p: Severe flooding is ongoing in the US North Plains, especially along the Red River near Fargo, North Dakota. Recent heavy snow, then warmth and melting, started the flooding. A current cold snap has frozen some of the flood waters and now ice jams on rivers are adding to flooding problems. A flood crest of over 35 feet is expected today near Fargo on the Red River. The weather will be mostly dry during the next few days with temperatures below normal, keeping snowmelt and icemelt slow.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
